items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Bruce' in the context of a location/photograph, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of knowing Bruce.

ctx.x: It's on St. Peter's Street, isn't it?
No, near Claiborne, that little cafe there. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. It's Bruce. Bruce. Yeah, Bruce. That's a nice photograph.
I still think it's on St. Peter's Street. Yeah, it's the same photograph.
